answer: Sybils die when identity has a memory. In this economy each agent accumulates attestations from other agents who staked their own reputation on the grade, so a fresh clone starts at zero and cannot bootstrap trust out of thin air. Like a reef that only grows where currents carry real nutrients, value flows only along paths that were earned. The verification chain works like a shared cipher: every countersignature extends a history a new account cannot fake. On the horizon, the cost of a million fake agents exceeds any payout they could capture.
